general_information.Description: The course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of both classical and contemporary marketing theories, as well as their practical applications. Throughout the course, students will engage with new classical and contemporary cases, exploring the interdisciplinary and cross-functional implications of business management theories, contemporary marketing management principles, and futuristic applications of marketing management theories and concepts. Upon successful completion of this course, students shall: 1. Acquire an understanding of the significance of management and marketing in various organisational settings. 2. Gain a comprehensive understanding of the fundamental principles that govern management and marketing. 3. Demonstrate outstanding analytic abilities that are critical for effectively tackling obstacles in business and marketing operations and reaching well-informed managerial judgements.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, questions, assignments given by instructor(s)/ lecturer(s) in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purposes - Promptly access to the FLM at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Display comprehensive understanding of marketing terminology and concepts.
Demonstrate proficiency in utilizing marketing and marketing mix components strategically.
Define management, management functions and management process
Discuss human resource management practices, including recruitment, development, motivation, and leadership strategies
Develop effective communication strategies based on an understanding of and the ability to apply marketing terminology and concepts.
Show professionalism, ethical behavior, and social responsibility while collaborating effectively on group projects.

assessments.Question Type: Opt.1: Group Project. Suggested topic: Analyse the unique marketing challenges faced by an actual company. Suggestions to augment the marketing efficacy of the organisation shall be furnished, drawing upon theoretical frameworks acquired throughout the course. Observations, in-depth interviews with company administrators and personnel, and a comprehensive review of the organization's documents will all contribute to the development of this assignment. Opt.2 (For Constructivism Approach only): Follow lecturer's proposal
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Assess the knowledge students have acquired in class up to the time of the assignment.
assessments.Grading Guide: Opt.1:Please refer to the rubric Opt.2 (For Constructivism Approach only): Follow lecturer's proposal"
assessments.Note: According to the predetermined LOs, lecturers have the flexibility to choose assignment forms. Each assignment has a six-day due date, which commences when the lecture provides detailed instructions.

assessments.Question Type: Opt.1:Individual Assignment Suggested topic: Examine the reciprocal association that exists between marketing and management.
